items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission officially confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed the scrapping and withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Withdrawn. The European Commission officially abandoned and confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.”
